expectations.text: Asks targeted clarifying questions in Portuguese covering at least: the current pain and why migrate now, measurable goals, alternatives, trade-offs, and impacted teams
expectations.evidence: _user_facing_response.md lists five numbered questions in Portuguese: 1 'Qual é a dor concreta hoje? ... E por que resolver agora?'; 2 'Como você vai saber que deu certo?' (asks for a number and for what is out of scope); 4 'O que piora nessa troca?'; 5 'O que mais foi considerado e quem é afetado fora do seu time?'.

expectations.text: Does not fabricate project facts (no invented stack, metrics, domain boundaries, or team names)
expectations.evidence: No project fact is asserted; every concrete figure appears inside a question as an explicit example ('De preferência com número: "lead time de deploy de 2 semanas para diário"'). The reply states 'Olhei o repositório e ele está vazio, então não há nem código nem design docs anteriores'.

expectations.text: Raises staying on the monolith (or a modular monolith / 'do nothing') as an alternative that must be weighed
expectations.evidence: Question 5: 'Modularizar o monolito sem separar em serviços, extrair só o gargalo, ou simplesmente não fazer nada — por que essas opções perderam?'

expectations.text: Does not deliver a finished design doc: if any file is created it contains only structure with explicit pending markers and zero invented content
expectations.evidence: `find eval-2-vague-write-asks-questions/with_skill/outputs -type f` returns only _user_facing_response.md — no document file was created at all.
